title: Cecilia: Towards Layout-Inclusive Optical Music Recognition
abstract: arXiv:2611.27465v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Reconstructing an editable music score requires musical events, sung text and the instructions that organise them on the page. Existing recognition targets often omit part of this information, while direct MusicXML prediction repeats substantial structural markup. We introduce Cecilia, a compact representation of canonicalised MusicXML that retains musical content, lyric attachments and layout instructions. Cecilia-OMR predicts this representation through metadata and measure-bounded music segments from shared visual memory. A learned count head determines the number of output segments. Across paired complete scores under a common tokeniser, the ratio of mean MusicXML to Cecilia sequence lengths is 27.73. Cecilia-OMR outperforms Legato 2 on Camera String Quartets and both Lieder conditions, with a four-condition OpenScore macro normalised edit distance of 0.2232 against 0.2998. translated_title: Cecilia：迈向包含版面信息的光学乐谱识别
translated_abstract: 重构一份可编辑的乐谱需要音乐事件、演唱文本以及将它们组织在页面上的排版指令。现有的识别目标往往遗漏其中一部分信息，而直接预测MusicXML则会重复大量结构性标记。我们提出Cecilia，这是一种对规范化MusicXML的紧凑表示，它保留了音乐内容、歌词附着关系以及版面指令。Cecilia-OMR通过共享的视觉记忆，以元数据和以小节为边界的音乐片段的形式来预测这种表示，并利用一个可学习的计数头确定输出片段的数量。在使用同一分词器的配对完整乐谱上，MusicXML与Cecilia的平均序列长度之比为27.73。Cecilia-OMR在室内弦乐四重奏以及两种艺术歌曲条件下均优于Legato 2，在四个条件的OpenScore上宏平均归一化编辑距离为0.2232，而对比方法为0.2998。（原文摘要此处截断：对歌词、记谱树与渲染结果的独立评估……）
tldr: 该论文提出Cecilia——一种保留音乐内容、歌词与版面指令的紧凑MusicXML表示，并构建Cecilia-OMR模型以元数据和小节级片段进行预测，序列长度仅为MusicXML的约1/28，同时在多项基准上优于Legato 2。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces Cecilia, a compact MusicXML-based representation that preserves musical content, lyrics and layout instructions, and Cecilia-OMR, which predicts it via metadata and measure-bounded segments from shared visual memory, achieving 27.73x shorter sequences and outperforming Legato 2 across multiple benchmarks.
